objective: Extract exactly one sequence-bound, per-record prompt/response pooled final-hidden substrate from the frozen Phase 1 teacher for hostile artifact verification before any representation-aligned training is designed.

pooling.name: dual_pooled_final_hidden_fp16
pooling.prompt_boundary: unique normalized-acquisition-prompt UTF-8 text span inside the exact rendered teacher prompt, mapped through the frozen fast-tokenizer character offsets
pooling.response_boundary: authoritative generated token IDs excluding the terminal <|end|> token

required_accounting: teacher input, output, and forward tokens
model load and teacher forward wall time
stored vectors, scalars, tensor payload, and file bytes
source identity and exact weight manifest
copied source parameters, stored logits, and training status
decision_rule: Run the no-model inventory first. If and only if every frozen count, record order, text boundary, response boundary, source file hash, and binding passes, perform one extraction. Mark the result extracted-unverified and keep training prohibited until a separately preregistered hostile verifier passes tensor integrity, provenance, accounting, and source-absence checks.
claim_boundary: This is pooled representation distillation. Extraction does not prove learned transfer, fluent generation, LayerCake host certification, Phase 3 completion, or superiority over LoRA or sequence distillation.
